newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 16.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary says the promulgation of five major laws governing the financial sector including the "Central Bank Law" two years ago has helped China's financial system to operate in a more healthy way.

- Competition in Shanghai's life insurance market has intensified in the past few years with the four major Chinese insurance firms competing with the American International Assurance Co, which now accounts for 13 to 14 percent of the market.

- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai names 54 industrial conglomerates which will enjoy special government support with the aim of pushing some of them into the ranks of the world's 500 biggest industrial groups over the next few years.

- Commentary warns stock investors against attaching too much significance to listed firms' interim results, saying the results are mostly unaudited and are not indicative of the firms' performance for the whole of 1997.
